title: 2014 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: Isabella had a week to read a book for a school assignment. She read an average of \(36\) pages per day for the first three days and an average of \(44\) pages per day for the next three days. She then finished the book by reading \(10\) pages on the last day. How many pages were in the book?

solutions.text:
During the first three days, Isabella read \(36 \cdot 3 = 108\) pages.

During the next three days, Isabella read \(44 \cdot 3 = 132\) pages.

Therefore, she read a total of \(108 + 132 + 10 = 250\) pages.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Convert each average into a total number of pages.
Add the first three days, next three days, and last day.
